title: Streaky Bacon Tacos with Azucarado Glaze
description: A fusion of Thai and Mexican flavors, these tacos feature crispy streaky bacon, marinated beef, and a sweet azucarado glaze.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Cook the streaky bacon until crispy, then set aside.
3. Grill the marinated beef for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to your liking.
4. Meanwhile, heat the Thai Red Chili Sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat.
5. Brush the azucarado glaze (made by mixing brown sugar and soy sauce) onto the beef during the last minute of grilling.
6. Warm the tacos according to package instructions.
7. Assemble the tacos by placing a piece of beef onto each tortilla, followed by a slice of crispy bacon, a sprinkle of cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice.
